item.description:
### New
- A profile can now use any picture on the web. Edit a profile and paste a link into **Custom image URL**, and that picture becomes the avatar on every device signed into your account. - **Browse avatars** opens a browser right in the profile editor, starting at the Nuvio avatar gallery. Tap a picture and it becomes your avatar — no copying links by hand. It works on any site, not just the gallery. - Every profile in the switcher now has an edit button, so you can change a profile without switching to it first.
### Bug fixes
- Choosing a new avatar now actually changes it. A profile that had a custom picture set kept showing the old one no matter what you picked, because the saved link always won over the new choice.
